task: Publish a legacy tag-based Cosign signature next to the Sigstore bundle so Kyverno 1.18.1 can verify portal images (narwhal#684).

events.summary: Scope: one extra `cosign sign --new-bundle-format=false` in the portal publish workflow's sign step. No cluster, policy or image change.

Kyverno 1.18.1 reports verify-image-signatures fail for ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal because cosign v3.1.4 writes only a bundle-format signature (OCI referrer) and no sha256-<digest>.sig tag (narwhal#684, measured earlier on the live cluster; research lane read Kyverno issue 16267 / PR 16800 and cosign v3.1.4 sources).
evidence: test:kubectl get pod annotation kyverno.io/verify-images / policy report on the live cluster -> fail for the portal image (orchestrator, measured 2026-11-16, narwhal#684)

events.summary: Added a second sign invocation with --new-bundle-format=false (decision D-dual-signature in the workflow).

events.scope: image digests, openbao backup manifest, mirror pins and version consistency
events.summary: The flag is accepted by cosign v3.1.4 locally; YAML parses. The signature itself can only be produced in CI with the repository key.
evidence: test:cosign version -> v3.1.4; cosign sign --new-bundle-format=false --help -> rc 0 (an unknown flag gives rc 1)

events.summary: Static change only. Whether Kyverno 1.18.1 then reports pass is verified after merge by a sign_digest recovery run on the released 1.1.20 digest and a pod re-admission; not claimed here.
